panel.title: Share & print
panel.intro: Hand out your album as a link, a QR code or a printed postcard.
panel.copyFailed: Copying isn't possible here – select the link and copy it by hand.
panel.shareText: Have a look at my photo album “{title}”:
panel.passwordNote: Your album is password protected. The QR code and the link do not contain the password – share it separately, for example in person or in a separate message.
panel.passwordHintLabel: Print the note “password is shared separately”
panel.exportsIntro: Every file contains your album's QR code in the colours and fonts of your theme.

postcard.title: Postcard A6
postcard.description: Front with cover photo, back with your greeting and the QR code. Includes 3 mm bleed and crop marks.
postcard.tip: Have it printed double-sided on 300 gsm card at a copy shop or drugstore photo service (100 % size, not “fit to page”), then trim along the crop marks.

stickersRound.title: Stickers, round
stickersRound.description: 12 round stickers (60 mm) with QR code and title on one A4 sheet.
stickersRound.tip: Print on self-adhesive A4 label paper and cut them out. Great for gifts, invitations and photo books.

stickersSquare.title: Stickers, square
stickersSquare.description: 12 square stickers (60 mm) with QR code and title on one A4 sheet.
stickersSquare.tip: Print on self-adhesive A4 label paper and cut along the lines.

posterA4.title: Poster A4
posterA4.description: “Scan me!” with a big QR code, title and link – ideal for table signs, doors and notice boards.
posterA4.tip: Print on regular paper (80–120 gsm) on any printer or at a copy shop.

posterA3.title: Poster A3
posterA3.description: Like the A4 poster, but big enough to be scanned from several metres away.
posterA3.tip: Have it printed at A3 in a copy shop. Laminate it or print on film for outdoor use.

socialStory.title: Story (1080×1920)
socialStory.description: Portrait image for Instagram, WhatsApp and Facebook stories.
socialStory.tip: Key content sits in the middle so the app's interface doesn't cover it.

socialSquare.title: Square (1080×1080)
socialSquare.description: Square image for posts, chats and newsletters.
socialSquare.tip: Works in almost every messenger and network.

qrPng.title: QR code (PNG)
qrPng.description: Just the QR code as an image with a white border, 1000+ pixels.
qrPng.tip: For use in your own documents, invitations or presentations.

qrSvg.title: QR code (SVG)
qrSvg.description: Just the QR code as a vector graphic – scales without loss.
qrSvg.tip: Ideal for print shops and design tools. Keep at least 4 modules of white space around the code.

exports.scanHint: Point your phone camera at the code.
exports.passwordHint: Password protected – the password is shared separately.
